name: hubspot-mcp-server-complete
description: Complete MCP (Model Context Protocol) server with multi-transport support for HubSpot CRM integration - implements all 21 MCP endpoints with HTTP, Streamable HTTP, and STDIO transports

scripts.prestart: node -e "if (!process.env.HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_ACCESS_TOKEN) { console.error('Error: HUBSPOT_PRIVATE_APP_ACCESS_TOKEN is required'); process.exit(1); }"
